noun.name: Wedge Antilles
noun.summary: Wedge Antilles, known as TIE SS-2-5 during his time at Skystrike Academy, was a renowned human male starfighter pilot from Corellia who first served in the Imperial Navy as a TIE fighter pilot until defecting to join the rebellion. He would also serve in the Alliance to Restore the Republic and years later the New Republic during their fight against the Galactic Empire. He became a member of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War and fought in several battles of the war. He fought in the Battle of Yavin, where he flew in Red Squadron alongside Luke Skywalker. After Skywalker destroyed the Death Star, he and Antilles were left as the only survivors of Red Squadron.

actors.name: Denis Lawson
actors.short_summary: 英国演员 / 导演 / 编剧 。生于苏格兰，佩思郡。以在《星球大战》系列电影中扮演魏吉·安地列斯知名。他也是《星球大战前传》系列电影主演尤恩·麦格雷戈的舅父。
